# yapp

> yapp is an open-source (MIT), local-first multi-agent chat server and full-screen terminal UI (TUI) for AI coding agents. Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Qwen, Kimi, Kilo, CodeBuddy, MiniMax, and OpenAI-compatible local models share chat channels over MCP, @mention each other, and are managed as tmux-backed agents in sessions. The package installs two equivalent commands: `yapp` and `goon`.

Website: https://yapp.riggedcode.com/

Install: `pipx install git+https://github.com/Ankitkkkk/yapp.git` (Python 3.11+, tmux on Linux/macOS/WSL2).

Safe read-only checks: `yapp --help`, `yapp status --json`, `yapp sessions --json`.

Scripting (all accept `--json`): `yapp new <session> --cwd /abs/path`, `yapp spawn <provider> --session <session> --cwd /abs/path --agent-name <name>`, `yapp send --channel <channel> "<message>"`, `yapp read --channel <channel> --limit 20`.

MCP server: `http://127.0.0.1:8200/mcp` (streamable HTTP) and `http://127.0.0.1:8201/sse`; tools include `chat_send`, `chat_read`, `chat_join`. Web UI and API: `http://127.0.0.1:8300`. Localhost only by default.

Data: `~/.local/share/yapp/` for package installs; `./data` in a source checkout.

## Docs

- [Agentchattr](https://github.com/bcurts/agentchattr): the upstream project yapp is built on
